dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated perimeters exhibiting a sharp gradient transition from a dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey interior. The prominent structures include both closed 'O' shapes with oscillating edge boundaries and open 'C' shapes with tapered endpoints.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters located primarily on the lower lateral and posterior regions; these features show high core pixel concentration with negligible internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a scalene obtuse triangle; a secondary grouping of four mid-lateral annuli defines an irregular trapezoidal polygon.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized, high-intensity orange/red pixel cluster is visible at the junction of the posterior body and the rear flipper.
